title: Choose the Supper Club AI composition
question: All three use the locked Speculative Salon Ledger world. Choose the structure to approve; for a combination or revision, choose the closest one and describe what should carry forward in the note.

options.label: Editorial Working Spread
options.lineage: literary journal opening spread plus annotated working plate
options.thesis: The dinner’s cultural thesis, full sequence, and selected course share one richly layered editorial spread.
options.viewport: A bold Seed & Stars overview anchors the left page, the selected course fills the working plate, and agent receipts occupy a dedicated right rail.
options.risk: It has the strongest editorial identity, but the dinner overview and editing task compete for first attention.

options.label: Run-of-Show Spine
options.lineage: event producer’s timed rundown inside the literary folio
options.thesis: A single chronological spine makes the evening’s arc primary and lets one movement unfold into a broad editing plate.
options.viewport: Six timed movements stack through the center, Main Table expands across the page, and shopping, prep, completeness, and export stay fixed below.
options.risk: It is clearest operationally, but could feel more like production management than cultural authorship if the editorial moments are quieted too far.

options.label: Expanding Foldout
options.lineage: six-panel cultural program score with linked editorial annotations
options.thesis: The whole dinner remains visible as six movements while the selected movement widens into the working surface.
options.viewport: Six adjacent movement columns span the folio, Main Table expands in place, and handwritten agent receipts point directly to the fields they changed.
options.risk: It is the most distinctive interaction, but its narrow collapsed columns require the most deliberate tablet and mobile translation.
